visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with short black hair is positioned in front of a metallic retractable gate in an outdoor urban setting. He wears a brown jacket with a gray patch on the arm and a small circular badge, paired with black trousers and black athletic shoes featuring white stripes. He begins performing dance movements, including hip rotations and hand gestures, while maintaining eye contact with the camera. The background displays a modern building with gray tiled walls and structural steel elements. The lighting is soft and even, characteristic of an overcast day. (2) The boy transitions into more energetic movements, spinning his body and thrusting his arms outward. His facial expression is concentrated and playful. The camera remains in a steady full shot, capturing his entire body and the paved floor beneath him. Yellow and white text slogans appear centrally on the screen, prompting the audience to guess the music. The gray panels of the building and the repeating pattern of the metal fence provide a structured backdrop to his fluid motions. (3) The boy walks to the side and then turns back, continuing his rhythmic movements with a joyful smile. The screen displays new text overlays in yellow and white that reveal the song title. He points and gestures towards the camera, demonstrating a confident performance style. The architectural details of the building's overhang and the depth of the outdoor corridor are visible behind him.
